title: Listen your way around the Musical Instrument Museum
description: At Phoenix’s Musical Instrument Museum, exhibits pair instruments with the sounds and performances that give them context. Move between regions and musical traditions at your own pace, pausing when something catches your ear. In the Experience Gallery, try making music yourself; a single rhythm can connect the displayed object to the hands that play it.
teaser: Travel through music without leaving Phoenix.
goodToKnow: This is a large museum. Give yourself time for rests and check current opening hours.
whyItMightDelightYou: Hearing an instrument as you see it makes an unfamiliar tradition immediately more approachable.
